fields.name: page-type
fields.label: Page Type
fields.description: The Site Global Template of the page (layout and template code). Overrides the page-type column of the metadata sheet.

fields.name: nav
fields.label: Navigation
fields.description: The header (nav) page of this page. Empty: the nav column of the metadata sheet, else the locale's references/nav.

fields.name: footer
fields.label: Footer
fields.description: The footer page of this page. Empty: the footer column of the metadata sheet, else the locale's references/footer.
